title: Number Processing Constraints and Earnings News
eligible_reason: The paper's quasi-experiment uses stock splits (Post = 1 after a stock's split quarter, staggered across stocks) with stock and year-quarter FE, but no published specification qualifies: Table 7 (Post on CSGrowth, absEPS, decile_absEPS) includes time-varying controls (size, BM, roa, lev, growth, investment, mom, IO, num_analyst, l2_price, illiquidity); Tables 8-9 estimate Post x Decile_SUE (treatment interacted with a continuous moderator) with controls and control x Decile_SUE interactions; Figure 5 event studies include decile_SUE and its interactions with relative-time bins; Table 11 is a stacked DiD (Cengiz et al.) with controls. The main tests (Tables 2-6, 10) are not DiD designs at all (CAR-SUE sensitivity by abs(EPS) decile).
design_notes: Stock-quarter panel of earnings announcements (PanelSample.dta, Tables 1A-6, 10, Figures 2-4) and a stock-split sample (StockSplitSample.dta, Tables 1B, 7-9, Figure 5) where Post indicates post-split quarters; splits occur at stock-specific dates; timetoevent gives quarters to the split. StackedDDSample.dta (Table 11) stacks each split event with never-treated controls and uses stock-by-dataset and year-quarter-by-dataset FE. Outcome of interest is the earnings-response coefficient (CAR x decile_SUE), i.e. an interaction, not a level effect.
main_or_robustness: robustness (stock-split DiD is a secondary identification check)
ineligible_specs_summary: Replication Code.do lines 138-146 (Table 7): Post with 11 time-varying controls, absorb(stockID yq), cluster(stockID). Lines 156-183 (Tables 8-9): c.Post##c.decile_SUE with $control (controls and controls x decile_SUE). Lines 333-337 (Figure 5): relative-time bins B_min..A_max plus decile_SUE x bins, absorb(stockID yq). Lines 227-259 (Table 11): stacked DiD with c.Treat##c.Post##c.decile_SUE and control triple interactions, absorb(YQDataSetFE StockDatasetFE).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Not computed; splits are spread over 1983-2018 quarters (many cohorts) but no eligible spec exists.
never_treated_note: StockSplitSample appears to contain only splitting stocks (timetoevent defined for all); never-treated stocks appear only in StackedDDSample (NeverTreated flag).
